question: What was the root cause of the EPS Hall sensor failure on project P-EPS-2102?
reference_answer: The Hall sensor supply had no transient protection, so load-dump pulses exceeded the IC's absolute maximum rating.

question: What was the root cause of the EPS bearing noise on project P-EPS-2102?
reference_answer: Castell Bearings changed the bearing grease to a different base oil without notification; the new grease channelled poorly at low temperature.

question: What was the root cause of the radiator tube-to-header coolant leak on project P-RAD-2101?
reference_answer: Brazing voids at the tube-to-header joint. The controlled-atmosphere brazing furnace belt speed had been raised from 0.9 m/min to 1.2 m/min to gain throughput, which shortened time above flux melting temperature and left insufficient fillet formation. The change was not reviewed in the PFMEA.

question: What was the root cause of the injector solenoid coil open circuit on project P-INJ-2203?
reference_answer: A worn wire-guide nozzle on the coil winding machine nicked the copper wire; the nick later opened under thermal stress.

question: What was the root cause of the inverter false desaturation trips on project P-INV-2104?
reference_answer: The desaturation blanking time of 1.2 us was too short for SiC switching transients at low temperature.

question: What was the root cause of the HVAC blend door actuator stall on project P-HVC-2102?
reference_answer: The door grease thickened at low temperature and raised break-away torque to 0.27 Nm, while the actuator stall torque was 0.30 Nm, a margin of only 1.1x.

question: What was the root cause of the GDI injector nozzle coking on project P-INJ-2001?
reference_answer: The new cylinder head placed the nozzle tip 20 C hotter than on the previous engine, which accelerated deposit formation in the spray holes.

question: What was the root cause of the BMS CAN communication loss on project P-BMS-2103?
reference_answer: The CAN interface lacked split termination and a common-mode choke, so injected common-mode noise corrupted frames.

question: What was the root cause of the inverter radiated emission exceedance on project P-INV-2104?
reference_answer: Common-mode current on the DC harness because there were no Y-capacitors at the DC input, and the 120 mm ground strap was too inductive.

question: What was the root cause of the HVAC evaporator odour on project P-HVC-2203?
reference_answer: Condensate drain slope of 1 degree left water standing on the evaporator; one batch was also missing the hydrophilic fin coating, so condensate formed droplets instead of draining.

question: What was the root cause of the compressor scroll wear on project P-CMP-2201?
reference_answer: At low refrigerant charge and low speed, oil did not return to the compressor, so the scroll tips ran without lubrication.

question: What was the root cause of the wiper park switch contact failure on project P-WPM-2003?
reference_answer: The sulphur-cured EPDM gasket from Seacrest Seals released sulphur, forming silver sulphide on the switch contacts.

question: What was the root cause of the wiper motor water ingress on project P-WPM-2003?
reference_answer: The ePTFE breather membrane was welded off-centre, leaving a leak path around the vent.

question: What was the root cause of the wiper motor worm gear wear on project P-WPM-2003?
reference_answer: Veltrix Polymers switched the gear material to a recycled POM grade with lower wear resistance.

question: What permanent corrective action was implemented for the BMS watchdog reset during OTA?
reference_answer: Background (non-blocking) flash erase with the watchdog serviced between sector operations.

question: What permanent corrective action was implemented for the sensor terminal fretting corrosion?
reference_answer: Terminal plating changed from tin to silver by Morrow Wire & Cable and a connector position assurance (CPA) added.

question: What permanent corrective action was implemented for the inverter power module solder fatigue?
reference_answer: Vacuum reflow introduced at the supplier; die attach changed from SAC305 solder to sintered silver from the 2023 builds; X-ray void acceptance made a CTQ at the supplier's outgoing inspection.

question: What permanent corrective action was implemented for the HVAC blower whine?
reference_answer: Two stiffening ribs added to the scroll housing, raising the panel mode to 910 Hz; impeller changed from 37 to 41 unevenly spaced blades.

question: What permanent corrective action was implemented for the radiator coastal corrosion?
reference_answer: Specification tightened to 8-10 g/m2 zinc; incoming XRF measurement of zinc load on every coil; SWAAT (acidified synthetic sea-water) test added to the DVP&R.

question: What permanent corrective action was implemented for the inverter DC-link capacitor degradation?
reference_answer: Capacitor changed to a humidity-robust grade (THB grade III, segmented metallisation) and potting changed to a low-permeability epoxy.

question: What permanent corrective action was implemented for the MAP sensor water ingress?
reference_answer: Automatic lubricant dispensing (silicone-free) and a poka-yoke that blocks the press without lubricant detection.

question: What permanent corrective action was implemented for the compressor housing O-ring leak?
reference_answer: Original compound restored; compression-set test added to annual requalification for all elastomer parts from Seacrest Seals.

question: How was the radiator inlet tank crack contained before the permanent fix?

question: How was the BMS connector pin push-out contained before the permanent fix?
reference_answer: All harness connectors pull-tested at 50 N before assembly.

question: How was the injector upper O-ring fuel seepage contained before the permanent fix?

history.content: What happened with the DC-DC output ripple on P-DCD-2102?
Output ripple of 450 mV at light load against a 200 mV specification; flicker on dashboard lights. It was handled in 8D-DCD-24-003.

question: How was it contained?
reference_answer: Evaporator batches checked for hydrophilic coating before assembly.

history.content: What happened with the HVAC evaporator odour on P-HVC-2203?
Orion Motors dealers in humid regions reported a musty smell at A/C start-up; 52 complaints. It was handled in 8D-HVC-22-005.

question: What was the permanent fix?
reference_answer: 5 mm keep-out from the break line, soft-termination MLCCs from Qiantai Ceramics, and router depaneling instead of the pizza cutter.

history.content: What happened with the DC-DC converter MLCC flex cracks on P-DCD-2102?
Short circuits on the 12 V output; ICT failure rate of 0.8% at the Pune line. It was handled in 8D-DCD-22-003.

question: What lesson did the team record?
reference_answer: High-impedance measurement circuits need cleanliness control and conformal coating; no-clean flux is not no-risk.

history.content: What happened with the BMS cell voltage measurement drift on P-BMS-2103?
Cell voltage readings drifted by up to 12 mV after humidity exposure, causing incorrect state-of-charge. It was handled in 8D-BMS-22-001.

question: What was the root cause?
reference_answer: Micromotion between tin-plated terminals under vibration caused fretting corrosion and rising contact resistance.

history.content: What happened with the sensor terminal fretting corrosion on P-SNS-2002?
Intermittent open-circuit fault codes on trucks with high engine vibration. It was handled in 8D-SNS-23-009.

question: How was it contained?
reference_answer: Stocked sensors checked with a high-temperature calibration check.

history.content: What happened with the EGT sensor drift on P-SNS-2002?
Exhaust gas temperature readings drifted by up to +35 C after 1,000 h, causing unnecessary DPF regenerations on Halden Trucks vehicles. It was handled in 8D-SNS-21-006.

question: What was the permanent fix?
reference_answer: Groove tolerance tightened to +/- 0.04 mm to guarantee at least 16% squeeze; low-temperature FKM grade specified.

history.content: What happened with the injector upper O-ring fuel seepage on P-INJ-2203?
Fuel smell after cold starts at -25 C; 12 vehicles with seepage at the injector cup. It was handled in 8D-INJ-23-006.

question: What lesson did the team record?
reference_answer: Neutral salt spray does not represent coastal corrosion. Use SWAAT for aluminium heat exchangers sold in coastal markets and verify sacrificial coating load at incoming inspection.

history.content: What happened with the radiator coastal corrosion on P-RAD-2101?
Radiators from coastal regions showed perforated tubes after about 2 years; 37 units returned. It was handled in 8D-RAD-23-008.

question: What was the root cause?
reference_answer: Partial discharge in the enamel wire insulation. The SiC inverter switches at 15 kV/us and doubles voltage overshoot at the motor terminals, exceeding the enamel's partial-discharge inception voltage (PDIV) of 1,050 V.

history.content: What happened with the 800 V compressor stator insulation breakdown on P-CMP-2402?
Two DV samples failed with phase-to-ground shorts after 600 h of endurance at 850 V. It was handled in 8D-CMP-24-002.

question: How was it contained?
reference_answer: Customer service campaign with injector cleaning for affected vehicles.

history.content: What happened with the GDI injector nozzle coking on P-INJ-2001?
Rough idle and misfire codes after about 60,000 km; injector flow loss of 7% measured on returns. It was handled in 8D-INJ-21-003.
